conventions: Format all code, JSON, and Markdown with Prettier (@backstage/cli/config/prettier: 2-space indent, single quotes in TS/JS, trailing commas).
Preserve existing Apache 2.0 license headers and copyright years on edited source files; do not add license headers to changesets, docs, or package.json/hbs manifests.
Follow STYLE.md: named imports from 'react' (useSyncExternalStore, useId) and 'react-dom/client' (createRoot); do not import from 'use-sync-external-store/shim' or import useId from 'react-aria'.

All in-scope workspace package.json manifests must set peerDependencies for '@types/react', 'react', and 'react-dom' to '^18.0.0' while preserving peerDependenciesMeta['@types/react'].optional = true.
Do not modify any ESLint, Prettier, or TypeScript configuration files (tsconfig.json, .eslintrc*, etc.).
Generated artifacts (yarn.lock, packages/test-utils/report.api.md, packages/cli-module-build/knip-report.md) are updated exclusively via tooling units, never hand-edited.

decisions.choice: Update react, react-dom, and @types/react peerDependencies to '^18.0.0' in all 56 workspace manifests and 4 cli-module-new templates, and set '^18.0.0' as the sole expected range in packages/repo-tools/src/commands/peer-deps/peer-deps.ts
rejected: Retaining '^17.0.0 || ^18.0.0' in private packages or templates
decisions.reason: Backstage now requires React 18 across all workspace packages and newly generated plugins, while React 19 support is out of scope.

decisions.topic: Synchronous createRoot rendering in dev-utils, frontend-dev-utils, and techdocs
decisions.choice: Import createRoot statically from 'react-dom/client' and call createRoot(...).render(...) directly, removing ReactDOMPromise, process.env.HAS_REACT_DOM_CLIENT branching, and ReactDOM.render fallbacks

decisions.reason: React 18 always provides react-dom/client, eliminating the need for conditional module resolution, bundler/Jest defines, and legacy ReactDOM.render fallbacks.

decisions.topic: Native React 18 hooks for external store subscriptions and component IDs

decisions.reason: React 18 natively provides useSyncExternalStore and useId with identical subscription and unique per-instance ID semantics.
